items.name: DriftGod
items.author: Public_Urinal / Animus
items.description: DriftGod for the Cherax Lua host.
items.compatibility: Requires the Cherax Lua API and any script-specific dependencies.

changes: Expands corner-speed assistance and first-use driving guidance.
Adds smoke and neon progression, animation presets and persistent activation preferences.
Improves popup, spawn and onboarding handling while retaining existing saved progress.
Introduces separate account score profiles, upload pacing and recovery.
Refreshes live leaderboards and blocks Story Mode submissions; identity and scores remain client-reported.
Combines online leaderboards, a Rival HUD and separate Drift / Power Glide rankings.
Adds first-run asset installation, onboarding and score checkpoints.
Adds Power Glide handling presets and Drift Smoke unlocks.
Improves dashboard navigation, garage integration and diagnostic dialogs.
Keeps manually chosen drift presets after startup and unlock checks.
Prevents chat input from operating HUD menus and improves reload and smoke cleanup.
Improves low-speed acceleration assistance and enables tuning when a base preset is selected.
Adds Prime-aware runtime and cleanup handling, recursive garage scanning and configurable garage shortcuts.
Establishes the production package with quieter startup, protected settings and revised rewards and HUD shortcuts.

Corrects the audio-scene full-level setting.
Checks the switches against game data and adds the Silenced option.
Adds controls for radio, weapons, alarms and other-player sounds.
Corrects handling of audio scenes that end automatically.
Repairs helicopter and footstep controls.
Groups additional switches and sub-switches into columns.
Introduces the Earplugs name, a grid layout and sixteen additional switches.
Adds weather, aircraft, location, pain, Arena and Car Meet sound controls.
Provides the initial seventeen-switch audio test interface and logging.

Expands the quest pool, adds level-based quest slots and saves progression between sessions.
Rechecks punch targets at impact, improves target assistance and introduces layered punch sounds.
Smooths trajectory rendering and adds impact markers, distance feedback and preview settings.
Restores saved settings, ignores hotkeys during chat or pause and adds trajectory and action sounds.
Restores visible living-NPC carry poses and separate handling for dead NPCs.
Repairs rage behavior, thrown-NPC collision and zero-valued rage bonuses; improves entity cleanup and menu controls.
